exposure: type of outpatient paediatric feeding clinic (speech pathology-only, dietetics and speech pathology, occupational therapy and speech pathology, dietetics, occupational therapy, and speech pathology)
cohort: 551 children receiving care for paediatric feeding disorder at a single-centre outpatient paediatric feeding clinic.
finding: Significant differences were found between different types of multi-tiered multidisciplinary feeding clinics regarding patient demographics, wait times, scheduling, service delivery methods, attendance, and outcomes, supporting their role in addressing diverse PFD needs.
